assets.name: hero-salon
assets.prompt:
High-end beauty editorial photography, natural skin and material texture, softly directional warm daylight from the left, deep warm walnut shadows, ivory highlights, muted bronze and taupe, subtle pale blush. Medium-format photographic detail, realistic depth and contact shadows. No text, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no plastic CGI look.
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: actual website hero photograph, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: richly layered beauty salon-inspired interior, warm ivory travertine, medium oak and walnut, upholstered sand salon chairs, tall curved mirrors, deep shaded arches and recesses, slatted wood, sunlight and realistic shadows. A foreground dark warm stone ledge at the lower edge adds depth. Chairs are center and right; show the room and believable architecture. The left third is calmer for copy. Beautiful rich tonal photography with deep contrast, never flat all-beige. Inspired by a warm natural salon swatch board; an editorial imagined interior, not a documentary claim of actual premises.
Constraints: no curtains, no people. Actual output photograph, not a website mockup.
